item.title: How To Create Erd Diagram Using Vertabelo
item.description: In this Tutorial, we will look at how to create Database Entity Relationship ERD Diagram using Vertabelo (https://vertabelo.com/) , which is an online paid data modeler tool. (you can check Free Online Tool to Create ERD for database) What is ERD Diagram? An Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD) is a amazing tool used to visualize your database structure and relationships between different entities. Itâ€™s essential for database design and development, as it helps you understand the underlying structure of your database, and how the different objects in the database interact with each other.
